_meta.purpose: Reference records for the works behind family_call_defaults.csv. Separate from references.json because these back an inference about a family, never a measurement of a species. A2/A1 still apply to the extent possible: each record says what the work is and whether its identifier was verified.
_meta.verified: doi_verified=true means the DOI was resolved against Crossref during import. false means the citation is recorded as written but the identifier was not confirmed, and the card says so.
_meta.no_source: The id 'none' is not a reference. It marks a family whose row in family_call_defaults.csv cites no identifiable publication (the author wrote 'scattered call libraries' or 'no family-level review'). Those families carry the strongest warning on the card.
